# Codex Chat Auto Title

> Windows utility for automatic Codex chat/session title generation using an asynchronous Stop hook, a local SQLite event queue, and a separate ephemeral Codex CLI request. Chinese: Codex 聊天记录自动命名、会话标题重命名、Hooks 自动起名。

Canonical repository: https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title
License: MIT; partial derivative of study8677/rename, credited in NOTICE.
Community project; not an official OpenAI tool.

- [中文说明](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/README.md)
- [English guide](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/README.en.md)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Validation boundaries](https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/codex-chat-auto-title/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)

Requires Windows, Python 3.11+ with pythonw.exe, Codex Hooks, and a logged-in Codex CLI. No extra API key or third-party runtime dependency. Naming consumes the existing CLI provider/account allowance and sends a short transcript excerpt to that provider. Default gpt-6-luna/high is configurable; model availability must be checked by the user.

Install from a complete source directory: python -X utf8 manage.py install --model YOUR_AVAILABLE_MODEL --reasoning-effort high --max-calls-per-day 30 --startup --start
The human must review and trust the installed hook in Codex Settings > Hooks.

Only recognized default titles are eligible; manual/uncertain, pinned, archived, running and already-processed chats are protected. Existing history is not batch-scanned. Only title fields are written; projects and ordering timestamps are preserved. Uses internal SQLite schema, which may change after Codex updates. Supported interface: manage.py and background.py, not the inherited generic rename CLI.
